source.title: Do a Thorough Due Diligence Before Buying Any Property
source.description:
A property being available at a huge discount can look like the deal of a lifetime. But what if the property has a complicated title or an outstanding bank claim?

This case shows how a buyer almost lost ₹60 crores because of a property-related dispute involving a bank, auction and title.

Never look at the price alone. Do your title and legal due diligence before buying any property.

pack.topic: Bank Auction Legal Risks & Property Due Diligence
pack.source_script_insight: Buying through a bank auction can lead to severe litigation if previous court orders or third-party claims are ignored, regardless of the bank's sales certificate.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Focusing on legal title verification for properties in Coimbatore real estate transactions, avoiding disputed parcels in developing peripheral zones.
pack.visual_strategy: Using real documents, lawyer desk review, stamp paper inspection, land boundary examination, and civil court reference files to demonstrate legal risk rather than using generic land plots or happy families.
pack.core_takeaway: Always conduct independent legal title checks before buying any property through a bank auction in Coimbatore.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK: Exactly 10 seconds total duration, native vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, full-screen photorealistic video composition tailored for Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu real estate market.

B. REALISM LOCK: 100% photorealistic real-world footage. No animation, no CGI, no 3D renders, no cartoon elements, no explainer graphics. Natural lighting, realistic textures of paper, wood, ink, and legal documents in a authentic Coimbatore advocate office environment.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK: Legal risk in bank auction property purchases. Source evidence points: 1) Bank auction purchases do not guarantee clear property titles, 2) Existing civil court judgments can override bank sales certificates, 3) Independent legal title due diligence is mandatory. Applied strictly to Coimbatore property investment advisory context without generic land promotion.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY: Focus exclusively on legal documents, court papers, title deeds, survey sketches, and lawyer verification desks. The default empty-plot, house, family, and construction sequence is strictly forbidden.

E. CAMERA + IMAGE QUALITY: Stable 4K-like smartphone and mirrorless footage, realistic depth of field, natural shadows, clear macro details on text and stamps.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT PLAN:
- Scene 1 (0.0 - 1.4s): Extreme close-up of a stamped legal auction notice resting on a wooden office desk in Coimbatore. Text overlay: 'Auction Risk?'. Voiceover: 'கோயம்புத்தூரில் வங்கி ஏலத்தில்'.
- Scene 2 (1.4 - 2.8s): Hands flipping through yellowed Tamil Nadu civil court papers and encumbrance certificates. Text overlay: 'Court Papers'. Voiceover: 'சொத்து வாங்குறீங்களா?'.
- Scene 3 (2.8 - 4.3s): Legal advisor pointing a pen at a property survey sketch showing land sub-division boundaries. Text overlay: 'Check Title'. Voiceover: 'பேப்பர் தப்புன்னா...'.
- Scene 4 (4.3 - 5.7s): Close-up of a bank sales certificate document being checked against property tax receipts. Text overlay: 'Verify First'. Voiceover: 'கோடிகள் வீண்!'.
- Scene 5 (5.7 - 7.1s): Advocate highlighting a dispute clause in a legal file with a red marker. Text overlay: 'Hidden Claims'. Voiceover: 'முன்கூட்டியே'.
- Scene 6 (7.1 - 8.5s): Lawyer stamping a property verification report on a wooden table. Text overlay: 'Legal Check'. Voiceover: 'டைட்டில் டூ கிலிகன்ஸ்'.
- Scene 7 (8.5 - 10.0s): Static shot of verified property deeds with a professional pen and subtle 'OliveTree Investors' text overlay. Text overlay: 'OliveTree Investors'. Voiceover: 'செய்யுங்க.'.

G. MOTION-GRAPHICS LIMIT: Only minimal text overlays on real physical footage. No cartoon elements.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE: Ends on verified property deeds and legal stamp, with minimalist OliveTree Investors branding.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT / FIXED RULES: No cartoons, no 3D renders, no explainer graphics, no plastic CGI, no fake landmarks, no landscape framing, no black bars, no repetitive shots.
pack.title_english: Avoid Losing Crores: Bank Auction Legal Risks in Coimbatore
pack.caption_english:
Buying a property through a bank auction in Coimbatore might seem like a great deal, but a bank sales certificate does not automatically guarantee a clear title. Hidden civil court disputes and third-party claims can trap buyers in years of litigation. Always conduct independent legal title due diligence before bidding or purchasing. Protect your capital with expert guidance from OliveTree Investors. 

#CoimbatoreRealEstate #LegalDueDiligence #PropertyInvestment #OliveTreeInvestors
